are_you_ok.title: Severe thunderstorms bring heavy rain, hail to Denver Saturday
are_you_ok.summary: Severe thunderstorms brought heavy rain and hail Saturday afternoon in Denver, southeast of Boulder, and out on the Colorado plains, the flat farm country east of the mountains.
questions: Any damage to your car or house to deal with?
are_you_ok.description: Severe thunderstorms brought heavy rain and hail Saturday afternoon in Denver and on the Colorado plains.

conversation_starters.title: Bear tears through screen, breaks into Colorado Cherry Company building to eat blueberry pie
conversation_starters.summary: A young bear broke into the Colorado Cherry Company's location on Highway 36 north of Lyons — the road running northwest out of Boulder toward the mountains, through the small town of Lyons about 15 miles away — to chow down on a blueberry pie.
questions: Did you see the bear that broke in for a blueberry pie up by Lyons?
Are bears getting into things where you live this year?
conversation_starters.description: A young bear broke into the Colorado Cherry Company's location on Highway 36 north of Lyons to chow down on a blueberry pie.

you_should_know.title: Trump administration accused of targeting Colorado with funding cuts, judge orders document release
you_should_know.summary: The Trump Administration reportedly targeted Colorado after Gov. Polis refused to pardon Tina Peters, the former county clerk convicted over a breach of election equipment, with claims supported by a critical email unveiled in court.
